newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Property slump fears send Manila stocks down.
newsitem.headline: Property slump fears send Manila stocks down.

text.p: * Property index down 4.36 percent to 1,412.86 points
Philippine shares tumbled in late trade on Monday on fears the local property boom could have reached its peak, traders said.

"There are concerns on the property sector after last week's rumours on Megaworld and Empire East," said Citisecurities trader Peter Chua said. The two firms have denied the rumours they were facing cash flow problems.
The main index dropped 1.79 percent to 3,005.79 points.
The main index hit a low of 2,991.34 points.
The property index dropped 4.36 percent to 1,412.86 points.
